descriptionChirho: The proper name Gedaliah (Hebrew גְּדַלְיָה / גְּדַלְיָהוּ, 'YHWH is great'), borne by several individuals including: (1) Gedaliah son of Ahikam, appointed governor of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar after the fall of Jerusalem (2 Kings 25:22-25; Jeremiah 39-41); (2) a Levite musician, son of Jeduthun (1 Chronicles 25:3, 9); (3) a priest who had married a foreign wife (Ezra 10:18); (4) grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah (Zephaniah 1:1). The two sense clusters differ only by the prefixed conjunction waw ('and Gedaliah') versus the bare name. Rendered uniformly: English 'Gedalyahu/Gedalyah', Spanish 'Gedalyah/Gedalias', Hindi गदल्याह, Arabic جَدَلْيَا, Korean 게달리야/그달리야, Swahili 'Gedaliya/Gedalia'.
